notes: Account: R&D + Platform combined team (product + infra) evaluating RAG stack for clinical document search.
Primary concern: PHI controls and full audit trail. Explicit ask for BAA and per-request access logs stored for 7 years.
Scale: ingesting 8-12M clinical documents (notes, imaging reports, discharge summaries). Expect ~60M total embedding vectors after chunking.
Performance targets: 95th percentile query latency <= 200ms for top-k retrieval+rerank on common queries; peak query load ~300 qps during clinic hours.
Cost sensitivity: target variable query cost < $0.02/query (including retrieval + rerank tokens); want ROI model vs current Elasticsearch infra.
Model preferences: prefer open quantized models for reranker (Llama-family or open-llama variants). Interested in Redwood recommendations for embeddings (128 vs 1024 dims tradeoffs).
Routing: need failover to smaller model variant for bulk batch exports; prefer dedicated capacity for 13:00-18:00 PST daily peak.
Security: VPC peering, private networking (no public endpoints for PHI), KMS integration required, SSO via Okta, SCIM for user provisioning.
Quote from CTO on discovery call: "We need deterministic latency for clinical triage — no surprises at 3pm when everyone runs queries."
Sales notes: AE introduced Redwood Dedicated as candidate; proposed 2-week POC focused on embeddings accuracy and reranker latency.

requirements_summary: Indexing: 8-12M source documents => chunking strategy to ~50-100M vectors. Need guidance on sharding & disk footprint.
Embedding cadence: nightly re-index (delta updates hourly for new notes).
Reranking: hybrid retriever (ANN) + reranker neural model for top-100 candidate re-score.
Throughput: steady-state 80-120 qps, peak 250-300 qps for 2–4 hours/day.
Cost target: <$0.02 per query including retrieval and rerank compute; prefer cost/perf tradeoff options (quantized models, batching).
Data governance: full per-request audit logs, immutable storage for logs, retention policy export (7 years), exportable for audits.
Network: VPC peering required, no public egress for PHI, optional on-prem connector for archive-only workloads.
POC success metrics: embedding recall@50 change vs baseline > +12%, reranker latency p95 <=200ms, architecture validated for VPC peering and KMS integration.
